chapter.title: Second Chapter
objectives: Identify the main goal of a lesson

lesson.title: Second Lesson
lesson.content: A teacher may publish additional chapters after creating the original course. Each chapter can contain a reading, review cards, practice questions, and a graded practice exam.

flashcards.back: A planned unit of study within a chapter.

questions.prompt: What can a teacher add to an existing course?
questions.explanation: The new chapter expands the course.
